subject: Coordinating Redwood demo with Acme Energy — IT/security required
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-energy.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-05T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Demo request: Redwood for energy forecasting

Hi Jordan,

I signed up on the Redwood site this morning and would like to book a short demo to see how your batching/cost controls could help with our near-real-time forecasting pipelines. We need the AE + SE to cover architecture and integration, and IT/security will need to attend to cover data handling and SSO.

Preferred windows next week: Tue/Wed 09:00–11:00 (GMT+1) or Fri 14:00–16:00 (GMT+1). Our security lead is Liam O'Neill (liam.oneill@acme-energy.com) — please include him.

Thanks,
Samira
Product Manager, Acme Energy
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-energy.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-05T09:25:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for energy forecasting

Hi Samira — thanks for signing up and for the details. I work with Jordan (AE) and can get a demo on the calendar quickly.

Quick options: I can send over a scheduling link for 30/45 min or propose a few times that include our SE. Would you prefer I share a public scheduler or we propose specific slots?

Also, any compliance packets we should prep for Liam before the meeting? We can attach SOC2 and SSO notes.

—Rachel
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-energy.com>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-05T12:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for energy forecasting

Hi Samira — Jordan here (AE). Great to meet you — thanks for the signup. Sergio (SE) and I will run the demo.

We want to include Liam / IT/security from the start so we cover SSO, data residency, and audit logs. To save back-and-forth, here are two options that match your Tue/Wed window in GMT+1, shown with Redwood team's local times:  

- Tue 2026-04-13 09:30–10:15 GMT+1 (Jordan: 04:30–05:15 ET, Sergio: 01:30–02:15 PT)
- Wed 2026-04-14 10:00–10:45 GMT+1 (Jordan: 05:00–05:45 ET, Sergio: 02:00–02:45 PT)

If those don't work, Rachel can share a three-day availability link. We'll attach a short agenda and our SOC2 summary for Liam to review ahead of time.

Agenda (proposed):
- 5 min intros & goals
- 15 min architecture + integration (SE)
- 15 min security/compliance Q&A (IT)
- 10 min next steps / pilot sizing

Would you like 30 or 45 minutes? I recommend 45 to leave time for security questions.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-energy.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oneill@acme-energy.com
Date: 2026-04-05T17:45:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for energy forecasting

Thanks Jordan — 45 minutes sounds right. We can do Wed 10:00–10:45 GMT+1. I've added Liam (copied). He prefers any pre-reads sent over; he likes a short SOC2 snapshot and notes on SSO flows (SAML).

One ask from IT/security: can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS/HSM and whether logs include per-token traces (for audit)? If you can mark these in the agenda that would help.

Samira
Product Manager, Acme Energy

On Mon, Apr 5, 2026 at 12:10 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samira — Jordan here (AE). Great to meet you — thanks for the signup. Sergio (SE) and I will run the demo.
>

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acme-energy.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-06T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood for energy forecasting

Morning Samira / Liam — Sergio here (SE). Wed 10:00–10:45 GMT+1 works for me. I'll cover architecture and SSO flows.

Quick answers to Liam's asks:
- Customer-managed KMS/HSM: supported in our Private deployment; for hosted we offer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) — we can include deployment options on the call.
- Audit/logging: we emit per-request traces and token-level usage breakdowns in the Console; we can show sample trace output during the demo.

Attached: SOC2-Summary.pdf (one-pager), SAML-SSO-notes.txt (SAML metadata + recommended IdP settings), and a short demo agenda (acme-demo-agenda.docx).

I've tentative-scheduled a calendar invite for Wed 2026-04-14 10:00–10:45 GMT+1 (calendar link below). Please accept if that slot is final.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/ical/event?eid=abc12345

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf (application/pdf), SAML-SSO-notes.txt (text/plain), acme-demo-agenda.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

- Jordan: send calendar invite with Zoom link + agenda (done).
- Sergio: prepare sample trace output and SAML metadata screenshot.
- Rachel: follow up with HubSpot record and a short pre-read link for Liam.
- Samira/Liam: accept calendar invite and share any additional compliance docs required.

See you on the 14th.

—Jordan Blake
